name: Caravan of Goodness
overview: The story begins with the Yolcu family, who lead a modest life, deciding to travel in a caravan as a result of a series of events. The family, consisting of a mother, father, grandmother, and three children, encounters people in need at almost every stop along their journey and tries to help them without expecting anything in return. Therefore, their caravan becomes a kind of "caravan," and their journey becomes entirely about "doing good."
